title: mysql 8.0 fix likely breaks on case insensitive

labels.name: blocker
labels.description: issue that must be resolved asap as it is preventing things from working

body:
**Migrated issue, originally created by Michael Bayer ([@zzzeek](https://github.com/zzzeek))**

e.g. #4344, we have this:


```
            correct_for_wrong_fk_case = connection.execute(
                sql.text("""
                    select table_schema, table_name, column_name
                    from information_schema.columns
                    where (table_schema, table_name, lower(column_name)) in
                    :table_data;
                """).bindparams(
                    sql.bindparam("table_data", expanding=True)
                ), table_data=col_tuples
            )

```

if table names/schema are stored in lower case that will fail.  user reporting this stack trace:
